Man Shoots Dog Over Barking, Injures Owner in Uttar Pradesh

In Uttar Pradesh, a man allegedly shot a dog dead because it was barking. The accused then reportedly fired at the dog's owner when the owner objected to the shooting. Police are currently searching for the accused individual. The incident occurred in Uttar Pradesh.
